observation: Rapid MCP tool calls and multi-command terminal invocations can appear to trigger OpenAI platform safety checks before ForgePilot receives the call.
policy: Prefer one MCP tool call at a time.
Prefer one logical operation per terminal invocation.
Avoid chaining multiple terminal commands when a single-purpose call is sufficient.
Avoid rapid back-to-back calls around enablement-adjacent tools.
Insert an operator-visible pause/update between sensitive tool calls when practical.
Treat platform blocks as observations, not as noise to retry away.
Do not rephrase or restructure enablement-adjacent calls solely to get past a platform block.
